source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001] — that sounds excellent, and I’m happy with both the approach and the timeline.

Let’s proceed.

For the initial step, I want to concentrate on:
• the system layout
• selection of the motor + components
• a basic wiring plan

The goal is to have a working prototype operating as soon as possible and refine it afterward.

Tell me what you need from me in order to begin.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey — I wanted to quickly clarify the scope of this milestone.

Given that the BOM has already been finalized and every part has been purchased and shipped, can you confirm that this milestone is now for the completed system layout and wiring plan, rather than another parts list to purchase from?

I also want to ensure we agree that no further components are required at this stage and that the project is proceeding into the build and integration phase.

Let me know what you think.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Hey [CLIENT_NAME_001]. I apologize for taking so long to respond this past week. I've been occupied with trying to complete your build. Regarding the food-contact materials, we're in a good position. Every area that touches liquid is stainless steel. The enclosure is constructed from PETG plastic, which is itself regarded as food safe, although the enclosure does not come into contact with anything. The silicones are food grade too. If components ever have to be replaced or exchanged, the machine is designed to be easy to service. Cleaning the internal plumbing might be more difficult than cleaning the other parts, but rinsing it after use and occasionally running a bottle brush through the plumbing should be more than sufficient to keep it clean. I have saved all of the documentation, including the CAD files, materials, Bom and wiring overview.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the wiring overview has been saved with the other project documentation.
